dedupe_keys.name: dataset of major agricultural disasters and disaster losses in china 1949 2015 china scientific data

description: Provincial statistics on agricultural natural disasters in China from 1949 to 2015: the affected area, the disaster area and the area of total crop failure, with estimated grain losses from a grain loss assessment model based on planting structure. The Science Data Bank records say the series spans events such as the Great Famine years, the 1998 floods and the 2008 snowstorm, and is meant for agricultural disaster prediction, prevention and reduction. Two V1 records were issued in late November and early December 2017 (registered with DataCite in 2022), each with two downloadable files of about 0.39 MB (format not stated), free under CC BY 4.0, as a supplement to a China Scientific Data paper. Creators' names are not given in the DataCite metadata read. Caveats: disaster categories follow Chinese statistical yearbooks, provincial totals hide local detail, and grain losses are modelled. For simulation it gives a 67-year record of crop disaster areas by province, to calibrate agricultural damage functions for floods, droughts and cold events and to test food supply resilience. Related catalogue records include the ADIA-CMGR agricultural drought impact dataset for China's main grain region and EM-DAT style disaster databases.
